name: RAW BOOT ICRNL: on, from the overlay, with NO page nudge
cmd: stty -a 2>/dev/null | tr ' \t' '\n\n' | grep -x -e icrnl -e -icrnl | grep -x icrnl && echo RAW-ICRNL-OK

name: the full termios, for the record
the 9p share is mounted at /files, 9p2000.L over virtio
the mount options are the ones S30files asked for
the login shell LANDS in /files, so temur starts there
the share is EMPTY on a fresh boot
the share is writable and reads back what was written
cmd: printf 'guest-side round trip\n' > /files/g.txt && cat /files/g.txt && sha256sum /files/g.txt && rm -f /files/g.txt && [ ! -e /files/g.txt ] && echo SHARE-RW-OK
